name: Brock K. Phillips Sr.
headline: Founder and Principal at Nuvara · Federal benefits professional · U.S. Army veteran
professionalSummary: Founder of Nuvara, federal benefits professional, U.S. Army veteran and published author. I bring evidence analysis, investigative judgment and clear documentation to complex records, operational decisions and practical technical systems. My career spans federal benefits authorization, counterintelligence, equipment maintenance and Army youth programs. At Nuvara, I define requirements, direct AI-assisted implementation, organize verification and make release decisions across web systems, infrastructure, learning tools and business workflows.

experience.title: Founder and Principal
highlights: Turn practical needs into project requirements, system designs, acceptance criteria and operating procedures.
Direct AI-assisted implementation of public web systems and private workflows across technology, learning, small-business operations, research and media.
Organize source evidence, testing, diagnostics and release records so deliverables and remaining dependencies are clear.
Maintain human review over consequential decisions and distinguish deployed work, supervised pilots, simulations and prototypes.

experience.title: Veterans Service Representative
highlights: Perform authorizer duties, reviewing proposed benefits awards, evidence and notices for technical accuracy and completeness before payment.
Reconcile service, medical, personnel and electronic records to identify conflicting evidence, missing information and discrepancies affecting proposed actions.
Authorize compliant actions or defer cases for correction, documenting defects and clear written guidance under established procedures.
Assess supporting records for relevance and sufficiency, escalating material issues requiring clarification or additional development.
Maintain organized electronic case documentation for continuity and quality oversight while protecting confidential claimant information.

experience.title: Youth Program Assistant / Youth Sports and Fitness Specialist
highlights: Coordinated sports, fitness and youth activities, including schedules, equipment and program requirements.
Maintained program records, inspection documentation and accountability procedures in regulated Army youth programs.
Monitored activities and safety practices and documented incidents and requirements for supervisory review.
Worked with families and program staff to provide clear service and apply program standards consistently.

experience.title: Sergeant · Counterintelligence and Utilities Equipment Repair
highlights: Served 3 years and 1 month in the counterintelligence specialty; earlier utilities equipment repair specialty totaled 13 years and 1 month. Held the rank of Sergeant.
Conducted investigative and analytical inquiries through document review, interviews, corroboration and credibility assessment.
Reconciled information from multiple sources and prepared written findings and briefings to support leadership decisions.
Handled sensitive information under procedural controls and maintained documentation integrity.
Supported maintenance, safety, inventory, operations and personnel training in the earlier utilities equipment repair specialty.
